# Data Cleaning
### First five of original data:
```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import re

messy_data = pd.read_csv("messy_address_data.csv")
messy_data.head()
```
## Part 1: Identify important data
The permanent address data is not important for the purpose of this project so we will drop them from the data set.
### Here is the first 5 rows of new data set without permanent address data:

```{python}
#| echo: false
data_no_perm = messy_data.drop(columns=["permanent_street", "permanent_city", "permanent_state", "permanent_zip", "permanent_region"])
data_no_perm.head()
```

## Part 2: Identify which rows are usable
#### Rows without data in the current_street column will not be useful as we need to narrow the location of each student in order to get the travel distances and times for each person
### Here is the first 5 rows of new data set without rows with null street address data:
```{python}
#| echo: false
data_no_null_street = data_no_perm.dropna(subset=["current_street"])
data_no_null_street.head()
```
